comparison.objective: Unpack six fragile eggs from a snapped-shut carton into a basket, versus commissioning and locking an adjustable robot-axis shock absorber through iterative physical test cycles.
comparison.physical_skill: The record tests bimanual carton restraint and lid opening, cap-only egg extraction from 1 mm-clearance cups, and repeated fragile-object transfer. The candidate tests recessed hex-key engagement, retained-setscrew loosening/relocking, controlled collar rotation, counterholding, and adjustment based on dynamic stopping response. Bimanual stabilization is shared only as a generic primitive.
comparison.success_condition: The record requires opening a 3 N latch and transferring all six eggs without any egg falling over 3 cm or breaking. The candidate instead requires two repeatable energized-after-adjustment carriage stops within published stroke, energy, and velocity constraints, without bottoming, hard-stop contact, excessive rebound, overload, or setting drift, plus verified physical unlocking and relocking. The record has no separate spec versions beyond its complete body.
comparison.reason: The tasks test meaningfully different abilities and outcomes: delicate extraction and transport of multiple fragile objects versus tool-mediated mechanical adjustment, locking, and dynamic damper commissioning. Differences are substantive rather than merely geometry, layout, or industrial labeling.
